bull_bear.body: Dependence on single asset class (commercial leasing); tenant concentration risk; lack of revenue diversification; regulatory risk in associate investment structure; no clear path to profitability

bull_bear.body: Cautiously optimistic; focused on cash flow sustainability, acknowledged losses are non-cash, highlighted associate performance as value driver, no aggressive expansion plans disclosed

bull_bear.body: The 100% CCPS holding in NDPL may represent a hidden convertible equity instrument with potential upside beyond the 49% equity stake; cash flow from operations exceeds net income by 666%, indicating strong underlying operational health masked by accounting
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

deepdive.thesis: The company shifted entirely to commercial property leasing, generating positive operating cash flow despite book losses due to depreciation, while its 49% stake in a growing food processing associate (NDPL) adds non-consolidated value. What matters is the sustainability of lease income and potential for asset monetization or REIT conversion.
